sentence_segmentation.method: original SciFact corpus abstract sentence arrays

passage.qwen_format: document title plus one original indexed sentence with the frozen EVIDENCE_ID marker

reranker.name: ncbi/MedCPT-Cross-Encoder
reranker.score: single raw relevance logit; higher is more relevant

conditions.P1: reuse Milestone 5A D1: BGE top-1 full abstract
conditions.P2: BGE top-3 documents, global MedCPT sentence ranking, top-1 sentence
conditions.G_full: reuse Milestone 5A D3: deterministic annotated document full abstract
conditions.G_rationale: one deterministic annotated rationale set, or no evidence for empty annotations

gold_rationale_selection.rule: minimum (sentence count, numeric document ID, sentence-index tuple)

feasibility.query_selection: first five numeric DEV IDs; verification labels not used
